Title: Azure App Service Basic, Standard, Premium v2 Plans Resource GUID change

Body.Content:
On July 1, 2019, some resource GUIDs (also known as meter IDs) for Azure App Service Basic, Standard, and Premium v2 Plans will change as the global region resource GUIDs will break out into regional resource GUIDs. There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines before July 1, 2019 that rely on the resource GUID and names.
